name: agent-coding-tools
description: Agents and skills for engineers using Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI.

plugins.name: product-owner
plugins.description: In progress: Product owner agent. Turns an idea into a problem statement, user stories with acceptance criteria, and a prioritized scope.

plugins.name: ux-designer
plugins.description: In progress: UX designer agent. Designs flows, screens, interaction states, and copy, and reviews interfaces for usability and accessibility.

plugins.name: architect
plugins.description: In progress: Architect agent. Decides structure, boundaries, data model, and technology, with trade-offs and implementation steps.

plugins.name: software-engineer
plugins.description: In progress: Software engineer agent. Implements features, fixes bugs, and refactors, following existing conventions.

plugins.name: qa-engineer
plugins.description: In progress: QA engineer agent. Writes test plans, finds edge cases, verifies changes, and writes bug reports.

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: In progress: Work with Jira Cloud issues using OAuth only, through the Atlassian MCP server, the Atlassian CLI, or the REST API.

plugins.name: figma
plugins.description: In progress: Read and work with Figma designs using OAuth only, through the Figma MCP server or the REST API.
